definition.name: ECAD / EDA
definition.overview:
An **ECAD / EDA application** is an engineering design application for electrical and electronic systems: the engineer designs a system of electrically connected parts by drawing **schematics** — diagrams of components shown as symbols and joined by connections — and the application understands those drawings as an electrical network, not as pictures.

The defining core is small:

```text
Component Library (parts with pin-level electrical interfaces)
└── Schematic Capture (symbol-based design of record)
    └── Connectivity (the electrical network implied by the drawing)
        └── Generated Deliverables (connection lists, parts lists,
            manufacturing / installation artifacts)
```

Everything else commonly associated with these tools — PCB layout, cabinet/panel layout, simulation, 3D, cloud collaboration, supply-chain data — is standard capability or variant, not the definition. A tool that draws circuit-like diagrams without connectivity semantics, an electrical part library, and derived deliverables is a diagramming or drawing tool, not this Type.

The Type has two market poles that share this one core:

- the **electronic pole** — circuits and printed circuit boards (symbols, footprints, copper, fabrication files)
- the **electrical pole** — machines, control cabinets, vehicles and wiring harnesses (devices, terminals, cables, wire lists, panel layouts)
definition.overview_zh:
一个**ECAD/EDA应用程序**是用于电气和电子系统的工程设计应用：工程师通过绘制**原理图**来设计电气连接的部件系统——这些图用符号表示部件，并通过连接关系将它们连接起来——而应用程序将这些图纸理解为电路网络，而非普通图像。

其定义的核心是精简的：

```text
元件库（具有引脚级电气接口的部件）
└── 原理图捕获（基于符号的设计记录）
    └── 连通性（图纸所隐含的电气网络）
        └── 生成的交付物（连接列表、部件列表、
            制造/安装工件）
```

通常与这些工具相关的其他一切——PCB布局、机柜/面板布局、仿真、3D、云协作、供应链数据——是标准能力或变体，并非其定义。一个绘制类似电路但不具有连通性语义、电气元件库和衍生交付物的工具，是绘图或制图工具，而非此类型。

该类型在市场中有两个共享同一核心的两极：

- **电子极** — 电路和印刷电路板（符号、封装、铜层、制造文件）
- **电气极** — 机器、控制柜、车辆和线束（设备、端子、电缆、线缆清单、面板布局）
definition.dc:
**Component library.** Designs are composed from catalogued parts, not freehand shapes. A library entry carries the part's electrical interface — its pins or connection points — together with part data (values, manufacturer part numbers, and, depending on the pole, the physical representation: a footprint for a board, a 2D/3D device representation for a cabinet). Mature products ship large libraries and connect to vendor-maintained component data portals; teams also author their own entries in dedicated library editors.

**Schematic capture.** The design of record is a schematic: the engineer places symbols from the library onto drawing pages and draws connections between their pins. Schematics are typically multi-page and often hierarchical — a block on one page expands into a sub-schematic. Every placed component instance receives a unique designation (a tag such as a reference designator) so it can be addressed unambiguously across all pages and reports.

**Connectivity.** This is what separates the Type from drawing tools. The connections drawn on a page are interpreted as an electrical network — nets between pins. Connectivity does not stop at page edges: nets with the same name are the same net, so a label on one page and a power symbol on another join the same electrical node without a visible wire. The application therefore maintains a queryable model of "what is connected to what," from which it can answer questions (which pins are on this net? which devices does this cable join?) and against which it can check the design.

**Generated deliverables.** The deliverables that drive manufacturing and installation are derived from the connected design, not drawn by hand:

- connection lists — netlists in the electronic pole; wire lists and cable schedules in the electrical pole
- parts lists (BOM) aggregated from the placed components
- pole-specific artifacts: fabrication outputs for boards (layer plots and drill data); terminal plans, panel layouts and harness documentation for cabinets, machines and vehicles
definition.dc_zh:
组件库。设计由编目部件组成，而非自由形状。库条目包含部件的电气接口——其引脚或连接点——连同部件数据（值、制造商部件号，以及根据极性，物理表示：板卡的封装、机柜的2D/3D设备表示）。成熟的产品提供大型库，并连接到供应商维护的组件数据门户；团队也在专用库编辑器中编写自己的条目。

原理图捕获。设计记录是原理图：工程师从库中将符号放置到绘图页面上，并绘制它们引脚之间的连接。原理图通常是多页的，通常是层次化的——一个页面上的块展开为子原理图。每个放置的组件实例接收一个唯一标识（如参考指示器的标签），以便在所有页面和报告中被明确寻址。

连接性。这是将该类型与绘图工具区分开来的地方。页面上绘制的连接被解释为电气网络——引脚之间的网络。连接性不会止于页面边界：具有相同名称的网络是相同的网络，因此一个页面上的标签和另一个页面上的电源符号加入相同的电气节点，而无需可见的导线。因此，应用程序维护一个可查询的“什么被连接”的模型。
definition.rules:
- **Connectivity is semantic, not visual.** Two points with the same net name are electrically connected even if no wire is drawn between them; conversely, wires that merely touch visually without sharing a net are not connected. This is the single most important behavior distinguishing the Type from drawing tools — and the source of a classic class of user errors that the checkers exist to catch.
- **Every component instance must be uniquely designated.** Reports, terminal plans and netlists are keyed by these designations; unannotated symbols are treated as errors.
- **The library is the quality backbone.** A design is only as correct as its parts: pin definitions, footprints/device representations and part data come from the library, which is why mature deployments treat library management as a governed discipline of its own.
- **Checks gate release.** Fabrication outputs, wire lists and panel production data are generated from a checked design; unresolved violations are meant to block or at least flag the handoff.
- **Schematic and physical layout must not drift apart.** Whether synchronization is manual (designer-triggered transfer) or automatic (one shared data model), a mismatch between the logical design and the physical realization is treated as a defect.
- **Deliverables are derived, never hand-drawn.** Editing a wire list or a BOM by hand does not change the design; the design of record is the schematic, and the lists are regenerated from it.
definition.rules_zh:
- **连通性是语义的，而非视觉的。** 具有相同网络名的两点在电气上是连接的，即使它们之间没有绘制导线；相反，仅仅在视觉上接触但不共享网络的导线则不连接。这是区分该类型与绘图工具的最重要行为——也是检查器旨在捕获的一类经典用户错误的根源。
- **每个元件实例必须具有唯一的标识符。** 报告、端子规划和网表均以这些标识符为键；未标注的符号被视为错误。
- **库是质量的支柱。** 设计的正确性仅与其部件相当：引脚定义、封装/设备表示和部件数据来自库，这就是为什么成熟的部署将库管理视为一个独立的受管学科。
- **检查控制发布。** 制造输出、线缆清单和面板生产数据由已检查的设计生成；未解决的违规项旨在阻止或至少标记移交。
- **原理图和物理布局不得偏离。** 无论同步是手动的（由设计者触发的传输）还是自动的（一个共享数据模型），逻辑设计与物理实现之间的不匹配都被视为缺陷。
- **交付物是派生的，绝非手工绘制。** 手动编辑线缆清单或BOM不会改变设计；记录在案的设计是原理图，而清单是从中重新生成的。

definition.name: Electrical Design Application
definition.overview:
An **Electrical Design Application** is an engineering design application for electrical systems: engineers design how machines, control cabinets, vehicles, and installations are wired by drawing **wiring schematics** — diagrams of devices shown as symbols and joined by wires — and the application understands those drawings as an electrical network rather than as pictures. From the connected design it generates the lists and layouts that drive panel building, wire-harness manufacture, and installation.

The defining core is small:

```text
Device/Symbol Library (devices with connection points + part data)
└── Wiring Schematic (design of record — single-line and multi-line diagram pages)
    └── Connectivity (designated wires and connections held as electrical data)
        └── Generated Deliverables (wire lists, terminal documentation,
            parts lists, panel/harness production data)
```

Everything else commonly associated with these tools — cabinet layout in 3D, harness formboards, PLC documentation, device data portals, multi-user platforms — is standard capability or variant, not the definition. A tool that draws circuit-like diagrams without device libraries, connection-point semantics, and derived deliverables is a diagramming tool, not this Type.

Label note: this Type names the electrical-engineering side of the electrical/electronic design family. The circuit-board side is documented under ECAD / EDA and PCB Design; the defining structure is shared, while the object world differs (devices, wires, cables, terminals, cabinets and harnesses here; footprints, copper and boards there). The overlap between the directory leaves is recorded for review rather than silently resolved.
definition.overview_zh:
**电气设计应用**是一种用于电气系统的工程设计应用程序：工程师通过绘制**接线原理图**来设计机器、控制柜、车辆和装置的布线方式——原理图中设备以符号表示，并通过导线连接——该应用程序将这些图纸理解为电气网络，而非仅仅是图像。从连接设计中，它生成用于控制柜制造、线束生产和安装的清单和布局。

其定义性核心很小：

```text
设备/符号库（带有连接点的设备 + 部件数据）
└── 接线原理图（设计记录——单线和多线图页）
    └── 连接性（指定的导线和连接，作为电气数据保存）
        └── 生成的交付成果（导线清单、端子文档、
            部件清单、控制柜/线束生产数据）
```

与这些工具通常相关的其他一切——3D控制柜布局、线束施工板、PLC文档、设备数据门户、多用户平台——都是标准功能或变体，并非定义。一个能绘制类似电路图但不具备设备库、连接点语义和派生交付成果的工具是绘图工具，而非此**类型**。

标签说明：此**类型**命名了电气/电子设计家族中的电气工程侧。电路板侧在 ECAD / EDA 和 PCB 设计下记录；其定义结构是共享的，但对象世界不同（此处是设备、导线、电缆、端子、控制柜和线束；彼处是封装、铜和板）。目录叶子之间的重叠被记录下来以供审阅，而非被悄然解决。
definition.dc:
**Device/symbol library.** Designs are composed from catalogued devices, not freehand shapes. A library entry carries the device's connection points (terminals or pins), its graphic symbol, and part data (manufacturer part numbers, technical attributes). Mature products draw on very large shared resources — vendor-operated device-data portals and manufacturer-provided parts repositories — alongside team-maintained collections, with dedicated editors for creating new symbols and devices.

**Wiring schematic (design of record).** The engineer places device symbols onto drawing pages and draws wires between their connection points. Electrical design uses two diagram forms: **single-line diagrams** (power distribution condensed to one line per circuit) and **multi-line diagrams** (every conductor of a circuit drawn individually), plus control-circuit diagrams. Projects are multi-page, typically structured by function or location, and every page carries a title block. Every placed device receives a unique designation so it can be addressed unambiguously across pages, lists and reports.

**Connectivity.** This is what separates the Type from drawing tools. The wires drawn between terminals are held as electrical data — named, numbered conductors and connections — not as lines on a page. The application maintains a model of "what is connected to what": wires are numbered (commonly automatically), connections cross page boundaries through labels and references, and coordinated device parts (for example a contactor's coil and its contacts, drawn on different pages) are linked by cross-references. Terminals are first-class objects: physical connection points where wires join, organized into terminal blocks and documented as terminal plans.

**Generated deliverables.** The deliverables that drive manufacturing and installation are derived from the connected design, not drawn by hand:

- wire/conductor lists and connection lists
- terminal plans / terminal diagrams
- parts lists (BOM/nomenclature) aggregated from the placed devices
- I/O lists tying signals to PLC addresses
- installation and production data: cabinet layouts, wire cut lists and lengths, harness documentation
definition.dc_zh:
**设备/符号库。** 设计由编目设备（而非自由形状）组合而成。库条目包含设备的连接点（端子或引脚）、图形符号及部件数据（制造商零件号、技术参数）。成熟产品依托庞大的共享资源——包括供应商运营的设备数据门户和制造商提供的零件库——以及团队维护的集合，并提供专用编辑器用于创建新符号与设备。

**接线原理图（设计记录）。** 工程师将设备符号放置于图纸页面，并在连接点间绘制导线。电气设计采用两种图表形式：**单线图**（每回路浓缩为一条线表示配电系统）和**多线图**（逐根绘制回路中所有导线），以及控制回路图。项目通常为多页结构，按功能或位置划分，每页包含标题栏。每个放置的设备均获得唯一标识符，以便在跨页面、列表和报告中明确寻址。

**连接性。** 这是该类型区别于普通绘图工具的关键。端子间绘制的导线以电气数据形式存储——具有名称、编号的导体与连接关系——而非页面上的线条。应用程序维护着「什么连接着什么」的模型：导线通常自动编号，并依据信号/电源属性进行逻辑分组……
definition.rules:
- **Connectivity is semantic, not visual.** Wires that share a name or label are the same connection even across pages; lines that merely touch visually are not necessarily connected. This is the single most important behavior distinguishing the Type from drawing tools — and the source of a classic class of errors that the checkers exist to catch.
- **Every device instance must be uniquely designated.** Lists, terminal plans and I/O documentation are keyed by these designations; automatic numbering is the common implementation.
- **Terminals are first-class objects.** A terminal is a physical connection point where wires join; terminal blocks are documented, and wire lists are organized around them.
- **The schematic is the single source of signal logic.** Cabinet layouts, harness documentation and reports inherit it; a mismatch between the logical design and a physical view is treated as a defect.
- **Checks gate manufacturing outputs.** Wire lists, terminal plans and production data are generated from a checked design; unresolved violations are meant to block or at least flag the handoff.
- **Deliverables are derived, never hand-edited into truth.** The design of record is the schematic; lists and layouts are regenerated from it.
- **The library is the quality backbone.** Terminal definitions, symbols and part data come from the library, which is why mature deployments treat device-data management as a governed discipline of its own.
definition.rules_zh:
- **连接性是语义的，而非视觉的。** 共享相同名称或标签的导线是同一个连接，即使跨越不同的页面；仅仅在视觉上接触的线条不一定连接。这是将此**类型**与绘图工具区分开来的最重要行为——也是检查器旨在捕获的一类经典错误的根源。
- **每个设备实例必须被唯一标识。** 清单、端子方案和I/O文档都以这些标识符为键；自动编号是常见的实现方式。
- **端子是一等对象。** 端子是导线连接的物理连接点；端子排会被记录在案，导线清单也围绕它们组织。
- **原理图是信号逻辑的唯一来源。** 控制柜布局、线束文档和报告都继承自它；逻辑设计与物理视图之间的不匹配被视为缺陷。
- **检查是制造输出的关卡。** 导线清单、端子方案和生产数据从经过检查的设计中生成；未解决的违规项旨在阻止或至少标记移交。
- **交付成果是派生的，绝不能手工编辑使其成为真实。** 设计记录是原理图；清单和布局从中重新生成。
- **库是质量支柱。** 端子定义、符号和部件数据来自库，这就是为什么成熟的部署将设备数据管理视为一个独立的受控领域。

definition.name: Industrial Design Application
definition.overview:
An **Industrial Design Application** is the form-defining environment of physical product development. It is used to create, refine, and visually evaluate precise freeform 3D geometry that defines what a physical product will look like — its shape, surfaces, proportions, and appearance — and to carry that geometry onward into engineering and manufacturing.

The defining structure is small:

```text
The product's form, held as precise, dimensionally real freeform geometry
└── form-first iteration: sketch/curve → surfaces & solids → direct refinement
    → visual evaluation → repeat
    └── manufacturing-bound exchange: geometry leaves for engineering
        and fabrication in geometry-preserving forms
```

Three properties hold together. Remove *precise, real-world-scale geometry* and the product becomes an artists' 3D modeling tool. Remove *form-first exploration* and it becomes mechanical CAD. Remove the *manufacturing destination* and it becomes concept visualization. Everything else that modern products carry — photorealistic rendering, 2D drawings, surface-analysis suites, AR/VR reviews, cloud collaboration, parametric options — is widespread accretion, not definition. Older and more minimal products (a desktop NURBS modeler from the 1990s, a stripped-down companion modeler with rendering delegated elsewhere) satisfy the same definition with none of that machinery.
definition.overview_zh:
一个**工业设计应用**是物理产品开发的形态定义环境。它用于创建、细化和视觉评估精确的自由形式3D几何体，这些几何体定义了物理产品的外观——其形状、表面、比例和外观——并将该几何体传递到工程和制造中。

定义结构很小：

```text
产品形态，以精确、尺寸真实的自由形式几何体保存
└── 形式优先迭代：草图/曲线 → 表面和实体 → 直接细化
    → 视觉评估 → 重复
    └── 制造导向交换：几何体以几何保持形式离开，进入工程和制造
```

三个属性共同存在。移除*精确、真实世界尺度的几何体*，该产品就变成艺术家的3D建模工具。移除*形式优先探索*，它就变成机械CAD。移除*制造目的地*，它就变成概念可视化。现代产品携带的其他一切——真实感渲染、2D图纸、表面分析套件、AR/VR审查、云协作、参数化选项——都是广泛的附加物，不是定义。较老且更极简的产品（1990年代的桌面NURBS建模器、渲染委派给其他工具的精简伴侣建模器）满足相同的定义，而无需这些机制。
definition.dc:
```text
Design (the product's form)
└── Precise freeform geometry  ← the unit of record
    ├── Sketch / curve layer
    ├── Surfaces & solids (or subdivision surfaces)
    └── Real-world units and dimensional accuracy
└── Form-first iteration loop
└── Manufacturing-bound exchange
```

- **The design's geometry as the unit of record.** The authoritative artifact is the product form itself: dimensionally accurate curves, surfaces, and solids (or subdivision surfaces) held at real-world scale. Renderings, drawings, review images, and presentation models are derived views; the geometry is what persists and what the organization builds on.
- **Form-first iteration.** The application is built around exploring and reshaping appearance: construction is direct and fluid — sketch, push, pull, blend, mirror — optimized for fast visual-structural convergence on design intent. Where parametric machinery exists, it is an option layered on top, not the organizing principle.
- **Manufacturing-bound precision and exchange.** Accuracy is structural, not cosmetic: the geometry is built so a physical product can be made from it, and the application must hand that geometry onward in forms engineering and fabrication can consume (neutral CAD formats, watertight solids and meshes for printing).
definition.dc_zh:
设计（产品形态）
└── 精确自由几何 ← 记录单元
    ├── 草图/曲线图层
    ├── 曲面与实体（或细分曲面）
    └── 真实单位与尺寸精度
└── 形式优先迭代循环
└── 面向制造的交换
definition.rules:
### The geometry is the contract

What leaves the application toward engineering and fabrication is geometry, and its dimensional accuracy and surface quality are load-bearing: downstream processes (tooling, printing, machining) consume shapes, not pictures. Watertightness and clean continuity matter for fabrication-bound output; several products provide dedicated watertight-mesh preparation for printing.

### Derived views never outrank the model

Renderings and drawings are projections of the geometry of record. When the design changes, they are regenerated — the reverse does not hold.

### Precision coexists with freedom

Industrial design tools deliberately de-emphasize constraint-first construction so that form can be explored fluidly; the counterweight is that dimensional accuracy must still hold where it matters (units, scale, handoff). How each product balances this — no history at all, optional history, or hybrid — is a product decision, not a Type rule.

### Editing histories typically do not survive the handoff

Neutral exchange formats carry shape, not the story of how the shape was made. Downstream engineers receive surfaces and solids they can reference and build on, which is why form quality (continuity, clean edges, manufacturable transitions) is inspected inside the design environment before it leaves.

### The loop is bidirectional across a tool boundary

Engineering changes typically come back as new geometry to evaluate and refine — industrial designers and engineers work in different applications over the same evolving object, with format exchange as the seam.
definition.rules_zh:
### 几何体是合同

离开应用进入工程和制造的是几何体，其尺寸精度和表面质量是承载性的：下游过程（工具、打印、加工）消耗形状，而非图片。水密性和干净连续性对于制造导向输出很重要；一些产品提供专门的水密网格准备用于打印。

### 派生视图从不超越模型

渲染和图纸是记录几何体的投影。当设计更改时，它们被重新生成——反之不成立。

### 精度与自由并存

工业设计工具故意淡化约束优先构造，以便形态可以流畅探索；平衡点是尺寸精度必须在重要地方保持（单位、比例、交接）。每个产品如何平衡这一点——完全没有历史、可选历史或混合——是产品决策，而非类型规则。

### 编辑历史通常不保留交接

中性交换格式携带形状，而非形状如何制成的故事。下游工程师接收他们可以参考和构建的表面和实体，这就是为什么在离开之前，形态质量（连续性、干净边缘、可制造过渡）在设计环境中被检查。

### 循环在工具边界上是双向的

工程更改通常作为新的几何体返回以评估和细化——工业设计师和工程师在不同的应用上工作，针对同一个不断演变的对象，以格式交换为接缝。

definition.name: MBSE Platform
aliases_zh: 基于模型的系统工程平台
definition.overview:
An **MBSE Platform** (Model-Based Systems Engineering platform) is the engineering system of record for the **system model**: it holds a persistent, structured, language-governed model of the engineered system under development, generates every diagram and view from that model, and lets systems engineers do their work — requirements linkage, architecture definition, behavioral analysis, verification planning, and generation of downstream artifacts — directly on the model.

The defining core is small:

```text
The system model (unit of record)
└── Diagrams and views generated from the model
    └── Editing governed by a defined modeling language
        └── Subject: the engineered system (requirements, structure, behavior, verification)
```

Everything else the market associates with mature MBSE — shared model repositories, simulation, document generation, requirements traceability, toolchain integration, embedded methodology — is standard capability of mature products or a variant, not part of what makes the product an MBSE platform. The Type exists in deliberate contrast to both document-centric systems engineering (specifications in documents and spreadsheets, with hand-maintained diagrams) and general-purpose diagram drawing: in an MBSE platform, the diagrams are not the artifact — the model is.
definition.overview_zh:
一个 **MBSE 平台**（基于模型的系统工程平台）是 **系统模型** 的工程记录系统：它为正在开发的工程系统持有持久、结构化、受语言管控的模型，从该模型生成每一个图表和视图，并让系统工程师直接基于模型开展工作——需求关联、架构定义、行为分析、验证规划以及下游制品的生成。

其定义性的核心很小：

```text
系统模型（记录单元）
└── 从模型生成的图表和视图
    └── 由定义好的建模语言管控的编辑
        └── 主题：工程系统（需求、结构、行为、验证）
```

市场上与成熟 MBSE 相关联的其他一切——共享模型仓库、仿真、文档生成、需求可追溯性、工具链集成、内嵌的方法学——都是成熟产品的标准能力或其变体，并非构成产品成为 MBSE 平台的要素。该 **类型** 的存在，是为了刻意区别于以文档为中心的系统工程（规范存在于文档和电子表格中，图表需手工维护）以及通用绘图工具：在 MBSE 平台中，图表本身不是制品——模型才是。
definition.dc:
```text
The system model (unit of record)
└── Diagrams and views generated from the model
    └── Editing governed by a defined modeling language
        └── Subject: the engineered system
```

Four properties. If any one is removed, the product is no longer recognizable as an MBSE platform:

- **The system model as the unit of record.** A persistent, structured model of the system under development, composed of typed model elements — structural components or blocks, functions or activities, ports and connections, states and modes, requirements, constraints and parameters — organized in containment structures such as packages or trees. Model elements exist independently of any diagram; the model, not a drawing, is what persists and evolves.
- **Diagrams as views over the model.** Every diagram is a generated rendering of underlying model elements. The same elements can be shown in multiple diagram kinds (structure, behavior, interfaces, requirements) and in non-graphical views — trees, tables, matrices, query-driven context views. Editing happens on the model; diagrams follow.
- **Language-governed editing.** Users create, connect, and modify typed elements, and the tool enforces the modeling language's grammar: which element kinds exist, which relationships are allowed between them, and what makes a model well formed. The tool does not accept arbitrary shapes on a canvas.
- **Systems-engineering subject.** The modeled subject is the engineered system as a whole — spanning its requirements, structure, behavior, and commonly its parameters and verification concerns — rather than software alone. The model is the working basis for the system's engineering definition and is handed onward to detailed design, verification, and production.
definition.dc_zh:
系统模型（记录单元）
  └── 从模型生成的图表和视图
      └── 由定义的建模语言控制的编辑
          └── 主题：工程系统

四个属性。如果移除任何一个，产品将不再被视为MBSE平台：

- **系统模型作为记录单元。** 持续、结构化的系统模型，由类型化的模型元素组成——结构组件或块、功能或活动、端口和连接、状态和模式、需求、约束和参数——组织在包或树等包含结构中。模型元素独立于任何图表存在；模型，而非图纸，是持续存在和演化的对象。
- **图表作为模型上的视图。** 每个图表都是底层模型元素的生成渲染。相同的元素可以在多种图表类型（结构、行为、接口、需求）和非图形视图（树、表格、矩阵、查询驱动的上下文视图）中显示。编辑发生在模型上；图表随之更新。
- **语言控制的编辑。** 用户创建、连接和修改类型化元素，工具强制执行建模语言的语法：哪些元素类型存在，它们之间允许哪些关系，以及什么使得模型是良构的。工具不接受画布上的任意形状。
- **主题：工程系统。**
definition.rules:
### The model is the source of truth

Removing an element from a diagram is not the same as deleting it from the model; diagrams can be re-synchronized or regenerated from the elements. Conversely, editing an element updates every view in which it appears. Products differ in how tightly a given diagram is synchronized, but the model-first direction is the defining behavior.

### Well-formedness is enforced

The tool constrains what can be created and connected according to the modeling language. Invalid structures are prevented at creation time or reported by validation; the user cannot silently accumulate arbitrary drawings.

### Traceability makes gaps visible

Because requirements, model elements, and verification artifacts are linked, unlinked requirements and unverified elements are computable states, not opinions. Changes can mark downstream links suspect until re-examined.

### Changes propagate across views and levels

A change to a model element appears in all its views; tools that manage multiple abstraction levels compute higher-level renderings from lower-level detail and offer impact analysis before deletions or changes.

### Concurrent editing is governed

Where a shared repository exists, concurrent work is managed through locking, merging, or branching with version history and audit trails; the exact mechanism varies by product.

### Method structure (where embedded)

Products coupled to a methodology structure the work into named engineering activities and phases; the method guides what to model next, but the underlying model-first loop is the same.
definition.rules_zh:
### 模型是事实来源

从图表中移除一个元素不同于从模型中删除它；图表可以重新同步或从元素重新生成。相反，编辑一个元素会更新它在其中出现的每一个视图。产品在给定图表同步的紧密程度上有所不同，但模型优先的方向是其定义性行为。

### 强制实施合式性

工具根据建模语言约束什么可以被创建和连接。无效的结构在创建时被阻止，或通过验证报告；用户无法悄无声息地积累任意图纸。

### 可追溯性使差距可见

因为需求、模型元素和验证制品是关联的，未关联的需求和未验证的元素是可计算的状态，而非主观意见。变更可以将下游关联标记为可疑，直到重新审查。

### 变更跨视图和层级传播

对模型元素的更改会出现在其所有视图中；管理多个抽象层级的工具从低层级细节计算高层级渲染，并在删除或更改前提供影响分析。

### 并发编辑受管控

在存在共享仓库的地方，并发工作通过锁定、合并或带有版本历史和审计跟踪的分支进行管理；具体机制因产品而异。

### 方法结构（如果内嵌）

与方法学耦合的产品将工作结构化为命名的工程活动和阶段；该方法指导下一步建模什么，但底层的模型优先循环是相同的。

definition.name: Mechanical CAD
definition.overview:
A **Mechanical CAD** application is the engineering definition environment for physical products. It maintains precise, real-world-scale geometry of components as the authoritative model of what will be manufactured, builds and changes that geometry by editing an intent-carrying definition — constrained sketches, features, parameters — assembles components into a product structure with defined relationships and degrees of freedom, and derives engineering drawings and manufacturing-facing outputs from that model.

The defining core is small:

```text
Engineering model of record (precise component geometry)
└── Intent-carrying editable definition (sketches, features, parameters)
    └── Assembly-level product structure (constrained component relationships)
        └── Model-derived engineering deliverables (drawings, manufacturing data)
```

Everything else commonly associated with modern mechanical CAD — the ordered feature tree with rollback, configurations, bills of materials, built-in versioning, sheet-metal environments, embedded simulation or CAM, real-time collaboration — is widespread in current products but is not what makes the product a Mechanical CAD application. Minimal open-source modelers, desktop SMB tools, history-optional direct modelers, and cloud-native platforms all fit the same definition.

The Type's center of gravity is **engineering function definition**: the model exists to define how a physical product is built, how its parts relate, and how it will be manufactured. When the center of gravity shifts to form and appearance exploration, the product is drifting toward Industrial Design; when it shifts to visual or media content, toward 3D Modeling.
definition.overview_zh:
**机械 CAD** 应用是物理产品的工程定义环境。它维护组件的精确、真实世界比例几何图形，作为待制造物的权威模型；通过编辑携带设计意图的定义——受约束的草图、特征、参数——来构建和更改该几何图形；将组件组装成具有定义关系和自由度的产品结构；并从该模型派生出工程图纸和面向制造的输出。

其定义核心是精简的：

```text
工程权威模型（精确的组件几何）
└── 携带设计意图的可编辑定义（草图、特征、参数）
    └── 装配体级产品结构（受约束的组件关系）
        └── 模型派生的工程交付物（图纸、制造数据）
```

通常与现代机械 CAD 相关的其他所有功能——带有关联和回滚功能的有序特征树、配置、物料清单、内置版本控制、钣金环境、嵌入式仿真或 CAM、实时协作——在当前产品中普遍具备，但并非使其成为机械 CAD 应用的核心。极简的开源建模器、桌面中小企业工具、可选历史记录的直接建模器以及云原生平台都符合此定义。

该类型的重心是**工程功能定义**：模型旨在定义物理产品如何构建、其部件如何关联以及如何制造。当重心转向形式和外观探索时，产品便倾向于工业设计；当转向视觉或媒体内容时，则倾向于三维建模。
definition.dc:
**1. The engineering model of record.** The application holds precise geometry of physical components — parts — at real-world scale and real-world units. This model is the authoritative definition of what will be manufactured; drawings, exports, and analyses are derived from it, not the other way around. The model persists and is edited over the product's life.

**2. Intent-carrying editable definition.** Geometry is not shaped freely; it is *defined*. A component is built as a structured definition: 2D sketches whose elements are held by constraints and dimensions, features that consume those sketches (extrudes, revolves, holes, fillets, patterns, shells), and parameters that drive them. When the user edits the definition — changes a dimension, a constraint, a feature — the application recomputes the dependent geometry. Design change is an edit to the definition, and the definition is what carries the design intent.

**3. Assembly-level product structure.** Components are brought into an assembly as instances and positioned by defined relationships — assembly constraints or mates — which specify how parts touch, align, slide, or rotate relative to each other. The assembly is the model of the whole product, including its degrees of freedom: what can move, what is fixed, how mechanisms behave. Sub-assemblies compose into larger structures.

**4. Model-derived engineering deliverables.** Engineering drawings (views, dimensions, annotations) and manufacturing-facing outputs are generated from the model and remain associated with it. The realization varies: a persistent drawing document that updates with the model, or exported model views in exchange formats; the constant is that the deliverable is *derived from and driven by* the model.
definition.dc_zh:
**1. 工程记录模型。** 该应用程序持有物理组件——零件——的精确几何形状，以真实世界的比例和单位。这个模型是将要制造的内容的权威定义；图纸、导出和分析都源自它，而不是相反。模型在产品的生命周期中持续存在并被编辑。

**2. 承载意图的可编辑定义。** 几何形状不是自由塑造的；它是被定义的。一个组件被构建为一个结构化定义：二维草图，其元素由约束和尺寸保持；特征消耗这些草图（拉伸、旋转、孔、圆角、阵列、抽壳）；以及驱动它们的参数。当用户编辑定义——更改尺寸、约束、特征——应用程序重新计算依赖的几何形状。设计更改是对定义的编辑，而定义承载着设计意图。

**3. 装配级产品结构。** 组件作为实例被引入装配体中，并通过定义的关系——装配约束或配合——定位，这些关系指定零件如何相互接触、对齐、滑动或旋转。装配体是整个产品的模型，包括其自由度：什么可以移动、什么固定、机构如何行为。子装配体组合成更大的结构。

**4. 模型衍生的工程交付**
definition.rules:
### Regeneration and dependencies

The definition's elements depend on each other — a feature depends on its sketch, downstream features on upstream ones. An edit triggers recomputation of dependents; a broken reference (deleted face, changed edge) surfaces as a failed feature that the user must repair. This dependency web is why change is *controlled*: the model's behavior under edit is predictable and traceable.

### Constraint states are visible and consequential

Sketches and assemblies expose their constraint state. Under-constrained sketch elements are flagged — color-coded in some products, listed by a degrees-of-freedom check in others; assemblies indicate which instances can still move. Reaching a fully defined sketch is a normal engineering goal, not an incidental UI detail.

### Fix is not a relationship

In assemblies, pinning a component in place is distinct from constraining it to another component; a fixed position is local to that assembly and does not express a relationship. The assembly needs an anchor — a fixed or origin-anchored foundation component — and everything else is positioned by relationships.

### The model drives the deliverables

Drawings and exports are downstream of the model. When the model changes, deliverables are updated from it — in associative-drawing products explicitly, in export-based products by regenerating the export. Editing a drawing does not change the model.

### Exchange carries geometry, not intent

Neutral formats (STEP/IGES-class) move precise geometry between systems but do not carry the feature definition; an imported model typically arrives as geometry without the authoring system's feature history, and further editing happens on that imported geometry. Native-format import across systems has the same character. This is why the model of record lives in the authoring system.

### Units, precision, and expressions

Geometry is held at real-world scale in real-world units. Numeric fields commonly accept expressions and formulas, so parameters can be computed rather than typed — a small but structural part of how intent is expressed.

### Suppression and variants

Features, constraints, and components can be suppressed — temporarily excluded from the computed result without deletion. Configurations (where supported) are named, persistent combinations of parameter values and suppression states, letting one definition yield a family of parts.
definition.rules_zh:
### 重新生成与依赖关系

定义的元素相互依赖——一个特征依赖于其草图，下游特征依赖于上游特征。编辑会触发相关项的重新计算；断开的引用（删除的面、更改的边）会以失败特征的形式显现，用户必须修复。这种依赖网络使得更改是*受控*的：模型在编辑下的行为是可预测和可追溯的。

### 约束状态是可见且具有影响的

草图和装配体暴露其约束状态。欠约束的草图元素会被标记——在一些产品中通过颜色编码，在另一些产品中通过自由度检查列出；装配体指示哪些实例仍可移动。达到完全定义的草图是一个正常的工程目标，而非偶然的界面细节。

### 固定不是一种关系

在装配体中，将组件固定到位不同于将其约束到另一个组件；固定位置仅对该装配体有效，并不表达一种关系。装配体需要一个锚点——一个固定或基于原点的基础组件——其他所有组件通过关系进行定位。

### 模型驱动交付物

图纸和导出位于模型的下游。当模型更改时，交付物从其更新——在关联图纸产品中明确更新，在基于导出的产品中通过重新生成导出来更新。编辑图纸不会更改模型。

### 交换携带几何，而非设计意图

中性格式（STEP/IGES 类）在系统间传输精确几何，但不携带特征定义；导入的模型通常以没有创建系统特征历史的几何形式到达，进一步的编辑基于该导入几何进行。跨系统的原生格式导入具有相同特性。

definition.name: PCB Design
definition.overview:
A **PCB Design application** is an engineering design application for printed circuit boards: the designer places components onto a layered board substrate and draws copper — tracks, vias, and zones — that realizes the circuit's electrical connections, verifies the result against manufacturing constraints, and produces the fabrication data a board manufacturer needs to build the board.

The defining core is small:

```text
Board (outline + layer stackup) — the design of record
└── Footprints (components as physical pads) placed on the board
    └── Nets (the electrical connectivity model binding pads together)
        └── Copper geometry (tracks / vias / zones realizing the nets)
            └── Fabrication outputs (artwork, drill, assembly data)
```

Everything else commonly associated with these tools — schematic capture, design-rule checking, 3D visualization, simulation, signal-integrity analysis, cloud collaboration, supply-chain data — is standard capability or variant, not the definition. Notably, the schematic is not part of the defining core: several products support laying out a board directly, without a schematic, and the connectivity model can be defined in the board editor itself. What the Type cannot exist without is the board, the footprints on it, the nets that govern its copper, and the manufacturing data that ends the work.
definition.overview_zh:
一个**PCB设计应用程序**是用于印刷电路板的工程设计应用程序：设计者将元件放置在分层的板基板上，并绘制铜——走线、过孔和覆铜区域——以实现电路的电气连接，根据制造约束验证结果，并生成板制造商制造电路板所需的制造数据。

其定义性核心很简单：

```text
电路板（轮廓 + 层叠结构）— 设计记录本
└── 封装（作为物理焊盘的元件）放置在电路板上
    └── 网表（将焊盘绑定在一起的电气连接模型）
        └── 铜几何图形（实现网表的走线/过孔/覆铜区域）
            └── 制造输出（光绘文件、钻孔数据、装配数据）
```

通常与这些工具相关的其他一切——原理图绘制、设计规则检查、3D可视化、仿真、信号完整性分析、云协作、供应链数据——都是标准功能或变体，并非定义核心。值得注意的是，原理图并非定义核心的一部分：一些产品支持直接进行电路板布局，无需原理图，连接模型可以在电路板编辑器本身中定义。此类型无法缺少的是电路板、其上的封装、控制其铜层的网表，以及结束工作的制造数据。
definition.dc:
**Footprints.** Components enter the board as footprints: the physical counterpart of a schematic symbol, carrying the pads (copper lands, with or without drilled holes) at which the component connects to the board. Footprints are placed, oriented, and flipped between the board's sides. Designs are composed from catalogued footprints held in libraries; mature products ship large libraries and provide dedicated footprint editors, and a placed footprint is typically embedded as a copy in the board so the design stays independent of library changes.

**Nets.** The application maintains an electrical connectivity model: nets that bind specific pads together as "must be connected". This model is what makes the copper electrical rather than decorative. Nets enter the board from an upstream schematic in integrated suites, from an imported netlist, or — in board-only workflows — are defined directly in the board editor. Wherever it comes from, the connectivity model drives the most characteristic display of the Type: the ratsnest (also called connection lines or ratlines), which draws every not-yet-routed connection as a direct line between the pads it must join, and disappears connection by connection as the board is routed.

**Copper geometry.** The designer realizes the nets by drawing copper: tracks (routes) that carry a signal between pads, vias that jump between copper layers, and zones (copper pours) that fill areas of a layer with a net — commonly ground or power. Routing is governed by the design rules (see below); zones fill automatically around obstacles while keeping clearance and connecting to same-net pads, often through thermal-relief spokes. The copper geometry is the physical realization of the connectivity model, and the gap between them — connections not yet routed — is exactly what the ratsnest shows.

**Fabrication outputs.** The design terminates in manufacturing data: layer-by-layer artwork (today overwhelmingly Gerber format), drill data for holes, pick-and-place files listing each component's position and orientation for assembly machines, and a bill of materials. These outputs are generated from the design, never drawn by hand, and they are the deliverable the board manufacturer consumes. Many products also generate fabrication/assembly drawings and can exchange richer manufacturing-data formats.
definition.dc_zh:
**元件封装。** 元件通过封装进入板中：封装是原理图符号的物理对应物，承载着元件与板相连的焊盘（铜区域，可带有或不带有钻孔）。封装被放置、定向，并在板的两侧之间翻转。设计由目录化封装构成，这些封装保存在库中；成熟产品会附带大型封装库，并提供专用封装编辑器，而一个已放置的封装通常作为副本嵌入板中，以使设计独立于库的更改。

**网络连接。** 应用维护一个电气连接模型：网络将特定的焊盘绑定在一起，表示“必须连接”。这个模型使得铜层具有电气功能，而非仅仅是装饰。网络在集成套件中从上游原理图进入板中，或从导入的网表获取；在仅限板的工作流程中，则直接在板编辑器中定义。无论来源如何，这个连接模型驱动着该类型最具特征的显示：飞线（也称为连接线或鼠线），它将每个尚未布线的连接绘制为它必须连接的两个焊盘之间的直线，并随着板子的布线而逐步消失。

definition.rules:
- **Connectivity is semantic, not visual.** Copper only "counts" where the nets say so: two pads are connected when a continuous copper path of the same net joins them, and the ratsnest keeps showing any connection that is not yet realized. The checker's unconnected-items report is the authoritative statement of what remains to be routed.
- **Schematic and board must not drift apart.** Whether synchronization is a designer-triggered update or a shared data model, a mismatch between the logical circuit and the physical board is a defect — mature products check for it explicitly.
- **Design rules gate the release.** Fabrication outputs are meant to be generated from a checked design; unresolved violations are meant to block or at least flag the handoff. Rule severity is configurable, and justified exclusions are a normal part of the workflow — but they are recorded decisions, not silence.
- **Deliverables are derived, never hand-drawn.** Editing a Gerber file or a BOM by hand does not change the design; the design of record is the board (and its schematic), and the manufacturing data is regenerated from it.
- **Zone fills are computed state.** A zone's copper is recalculated from the outline, the rules, and the objects it interacts with; products treat stale fills as an error condition before checking or output, because the fill is what actually gets manufactured.
- **The library is the quality backbone.** Pad geometry, courtyard outlines, and 3D models come from footprints; a wrong footprint produces a board that cannot be assembled. Mature deployments treat library maintenance as a governed discipline, and boards embed library copies so they do not change unexpectedly.
- **The board outline is load-bearing.** Zones fill only inside it, 3D and several checks depend on it being a valid closed shape, and mechanical fit is judged against it — a malformed outline is itself a checkable violation.
definition.rules_zh:
- **连接性是语义性的，而非视觉性的。** 铜层仅在网表指示的地方才“算数”：两个焊盘在相同的网表通过连续铜路径连接时才算连接，而飞线会持续显示任何尚未实现的连接。检查器的未连接项目报告是剩余待布线内容的权威声明。
- **原理图与电路板不得出现偏差。** 无论是由设计者触发的更新还是共享数据模型，逻辑电路与物理电路板之间的不匹配都是缺陷——成熟产品会明确检查这一点。
- **设计规则控制发布。** 制造输出应从经过检查的设计中生成；未解决的违规旨在阻止或至少标记移交。规则严重性可配置，合理的排除是工作流程的正常部分——但它们是已记录的决策，而非默许。
- **交付物是派生的，绝非手工绘制。** 手动编辑Gerber文件或BOM不会改变设计；设计记录本是电路板（及其原理图），制造数据从中重新生成。
- **区域填充是计算状态。** 区域的铜层根据轮廓、规则及其交互对象重新计算；产品在检查或输出之前将过时的填充视为错误条件，因为填充是实际被制造的内容。
- **库是质量的支柱。** 焊盘几何图形、Courtyard轮廓和3D模型来自封装；错误的封装会产生无法组装的电路板。成熟的部署将库维护视为受控的学科，电路板嵌入库副本以防意外更改。
- **电路板轮廓是承重的。** 区域仅在其内部填充，3D和一些检查依赖于它

definition.name: Semiconductor Design Platform
definition.overview:
A **Semiconductor Design Platform** is the software environment in which an integrated circuit — a chip — is designed, verified, and prepared for fabrication. The industry calls this domain electronic design automation (EDA); this document covers the chip-design side of it, as distinct from board- and system-level electrical design tools.

The defining structure of the Type has three parts that always appear together:

```text
The chip design held as corresponding representations
    (functional description → circuit realization → physical layout)
        + verification against electrical behavior and manufacturing reality
            (simulation + process-rule checking, findings gate progress)
                + a transformation flow ending in fabrication-ready
                  manufacturing data (mask data a wafer fab can build)
```

Everything else the market associates with chip design — RTL synthesis engines, place-and-route automation, AI-assisted optimization, cloud delivery, 3D-IC packaging flows — is carried by current mature products but is not what makes the software this Type. A tool set that holds the three-part core is recognizable as a chip-design environment whether it is a modern AI-enhanced suite, a regional vendor's analog flow, or an older, manually operated environment.

When the object of work becomes a printed circuit board, a mechanical part, a running piece of software, or a programmed FPGA device, the product has moved into a different Application Type.
definition.overview_zh:
一个**半导体设计平台**是用于设计、验证并准备集成电路——即芯片——制造的软件环境。业界将该领域称为电子设计自动化（EDA）；本文档涵盖芯片设计方面，区别于板级和系统级电气设计工具。

该类型的定义性结构由始终共同出现的三个部分组成：

```text
以对应表示形式保存的芯片设计
    （功能描述 → 电路实现 → 物理版图）
        + 针对电气行为和制造现实的验证
            （仿真 + 工艺规则检查，发现结果决定进度）
                + 以可制造的制造数据（掩膜数据，晶圆厂可以制造）结束的转换流程
```

市场与芯片设计相关联的其他所有事物——RTL综合引擎、布局布线自动化、AI辅助优化、云交付、3D-IC封装流程——均由当前的成熟产品承载，但它们并非定义该软件类型的核心。一个包含三部分核心的工具集，无论是现代AI增强套件、区域供应商的模拟流程，还是较旧的、手动操作的环境，均可被识别为芯片设计环境。

当工作对象变为印刷电路板、机械零件、运行中的软件或已编程的FPGA器件时，该产品已进入不同的应用类型。
definition.dc: The central object is the chip design itself, held as several representations of the same circuit at different levels of detail, all connected:
definition.dc_zh: 中心对象是芯片设计本身，以同一电路在不同细节级别的多个表示形式保存，所有这些都相互连接。
definition.rules:
- **Manufacturability is process-relative.** Design rules and device models belong to a specific silicon process. A layout clean against one process says nothing about another; migrating a design to a new process is a real project with its own tooling.
- **Correspondence must be proven, and re-proven.** The layout must match the netlist and the netlist must match the description. Every targeted edit late in the flow (an ECO) must be followed by renewed equivalence proof.
- **Routed reality beats estimates.** Wiring has electrical consequences (delay, coupling, voltage drop). Timing, power, and signal-integrity signoff happens against parasitics extracted from the actual layout, and closure iterates on those results.
- **Signoff gates manufacturing.** The design leaves for fabrication only when the trusted-tool checks are clean under the process owner's criteria; foundries certify which flows they accept. Unverified optimism has no path to silicon.
- **Verification dominates effort.** Industry claims — and the size of the verification tool families — make verification the largest single body of work on a chip project (one major vendor publishes a figure of up to seventy percent of the design cycle).
- **Automation depth differs by domain, not by quality.** Digital flows are highly automated pipelines; custom analog flows deliberately keep the human in the drawing loop, with automation assisting rather than replacing craft. Both are normal for the Type.
- **The design is big and hierarchical.** Modern chips are decomposed into blocks and worked in parallel; tools are built for very large hierarchical data, and results are attached to specific places in that hierarchy.
definition.rules_zh:
- **可制造性是工艺相关的。** 设计规则和器件模型属于特定的硅工艺。针对某一工艺清理干净的版图，无法说明其适用于另一工艺；将设计迁移到新工艺是一个独立项目，有其自身的工具集。
- **对应关系必须被证明，并且反复证明。** 版图必须匹配网表，网表必须匹配描述。后期每次有针对性的编辑（ECO）之后，都必须重新进行等价性证明。
- **布线后的现实优于估算。** 布线具有电气影响（延迟、耦合、电压降）。时序、功耗和信号完整性签核是基于从实际版图中提取的寄生参数进行的，并且收敛基于这些结果迭代。
- **签核是制造的关口。** 设计只有在受信任工具在工艺所有者标准下的检查均通过后，才能送往制造；代工厂会认证其接受的流程。未经验证的乐观无法通往硅片。
- **验证主导工作量。** 行业声明——以及验证工具系列的规模——表明验证是芯片项目中最大的单项工作（一家主要供应商公布的数据显示，其占设计周期的百分之七十）。
- **自动化深度因领域而异，并非质量有别。** 数字流程是高度自动化的流水线；定制模拟流程则有意将人员保留在绘图循环中，自动化是辅助而非取代工艺。两者对于该类型而言都是正常的。
- **设计规模庞大且分层。** 现代芯片被分解为模块并行工作；工具为非常大的分层数据而构建，结果附着在该层次结构中的特定位置。
